Element.attribute: Resposible for defining and executing activities required to plan, deliver and manage an Oracle services implementation project or transformation program.

Element.DisplayName: EY Accelerate (EYA) Methodology for Oracle Services
Element.Name: eya_oracle_methodology
initiate_project
Element.attribute: Identify key client stakeholders and establish the core project team with representation from the client and EY. Additionally, develop the project charter and schedule and formally launch the project with the core team.

Element.Name: define_project_manage_plan
Element.attribute: Define the project governance structure, design authority and document the project management plan (PMP).

Element.Name: define_ini_backlog_agile
Element.attribute: Define an initial backlog in order to better estimate the work effort and prepare for the progressive build cycles.

Element.Name: doc_def_done_ready
Element.DisplayName: Document the definitions of done and ready

Element.Name: plan_prog_build_cycle
Element.attribute: Define the overall implementation plan as well as the release plan that details the configurations and RICEFW objects that will be completed in each build iteration (1-n). Additionally, define the iteration cadence and synchronization of work.

Element.Name: manage_backlog_depend_trace
Element.attribute: Throughout the implementation, actively manage the backlog. Document dependencies and govern traceability.

Element.Name: execute_proj
Element.attribute: Deliver the work defined in the project management plan to satisfy the project specifications.

Element.Name: monitor_ctrl_proj
Element.attribute: Track, review, and regulate the progress and performance of the project; identify any areas in which changes to the plan are required; and initiate the corresponding changes.

Element.Name: track_monitor_benefits_real
Element.attribute: Create a benefits realization plan and actively monitor the realization of benefits throughout the transformation journey.

Element.DisplayName: Identify additional benefit opportunities or benefits realized

Element.attribute: Meet with key client stakeholders to formally close the program or project.
